_note: Power zone. Generator -> trunk cable -> per-level junction -> buildings, with transmission loss scaling by distance. Junctions have capacity caps, so a well-supplied Shaft can still starve a level.

buildings.name: Main generator
buildings._note: Single point of failure by design. The precision component in its repair cost is what makes a generator fault a multi-day crisis rather than an afternoon's work.

buildings.name: Battery bank
buildings._note: Buffers against generator faults. Buys minutes, not hours — enough to get the priority ladder to do its job in an orderly way.

buildings.name: Junction
buildings._note: One per level, or that level draws through a neighbour's and eats the extra transmission loss.
